capabilities: Preview Markdown notes as Slidev decks in an embedded presentation view
Keep the displayed slide aligned with the cursor position
Install a version-pinned Slidev starter project into the vault via npm
Connect to an existing Slidev project or an already-running local server
Open the current slide in a browser or Slidev's presenter view
extras: Desktop-only; starts a local Node.js/npm process and embeds a local Vite server. Detailed disclosures note that npm install scripts and Slidev presentations can execute JavaScript, so users should only trust dependencies and project code they set up.
problem: Obsidian's core Slides feature is minimal, so users who want Slidev's themes, addons, components, and presenter view have to leave the vault to present their notes.

relations.evidence: Preview Markdown presentations from your Obsidian vault with Slidev.

summary: Embedded Slidev viewer that renders Markdown notes as slide presentations, keeping the displayed slide aligned with the cursor.
